note: Both sets are essentially identical in content and accuracy: formulas for ωφn, ζφ, Kp and KI are correctly transcribed and bound, and conditions (Region 3, Ref. [10] design recommendation) are kept. Set A, however, repeats the generator-torque negative-damping claim verbatim under a nearly identical attribute name, adding a duplicate with no new information. Set B is therefore slightly cleaner, though both sets also state the 0.6 rad/s and 0.6–0.7 targets twice (once as response target, once as controller recommendation).
remarks: Both sets omit several engineering statements on the page: the derivative term increases effective drivetrain inertia, the proportional term adds damping, the integral term adds restoring, the negative damping must be compensated by the proportional blade-pitch term, and Ref. [10] recommends neglecting the derivative gain and ignoring the generator-torque negative damping. The text layer is heavily garbled for the equations, but the page image renders them legibly.
